name: VR Neighborhood
summary:
VR Neighborhood, Inc. is a social friendly platform dedicated to making innovative residential home design accessible to anyone, anytime, anywhere in the world through VR.

Visit, meet your friends, host parties, or just hang out in amazing VR homes designed by award-winning architects and designers from around the world.
